name: PowerShell Dev Container (Wolfi)
postCreateCommand: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Import-Module Pester; Import-Module PSScriptAnalyzer; $pesterVersion = (Get-Module -Name Pester -ListAvailable | Sort-Object Version -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).Version; $pssaVersion = (Get-Module -Name PSScriptAnalyzer -ListAvailable | Sort-Object Version -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).Version; Write-Host ('pwsh: ' + $PSVersionTable.PSVersion); Write-Host ('Pester: ' + $pesterVersion); Write-Host ('PSScriptAnalyzer: ' + $pssaVersion)"
